He placed the bottle on the windowsill, facing the water, and left the lamp burning until morning.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘暂时靠岸的船。写字楼的灯一盏盏熄灭，便利店的白光仍照着空荡的货架。环卫车缓慢转过街角，水花把霓虹推成模糊的长线。高架桥上偶有出租车驶过，载着没说出口的心事。包子铺冒出第一缕蒸汽，远处天色由黑转青。鸟鸣尚未开始，红绿灯安静地变换，替沉睡的人群数着时间。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions includes a smaller version of the same job.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box, and repeating until you find the prize.\n- The stopping point matters: once you find the prize, you stop opening boxes and finish each job on the way back."}
